crops.name: Rice (Paddy)

fertilizer_schedule.top_dress_1: Urea 40 kg/ha at 20-25 days after transplanting

crops.irrigation: Keep 2-5 cm water standing during vegetative stage; drain field 10 days before harvest
crops.storage: Moisture below 14%; use metal bins or hermetic bags
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest when 80% grains turn golden yellow; use combine harvester for large fields

crops.name: Wheat

fertilizer_schedule.basal: DAP 50 kg/ha + Urea 30 kg/ha at sowing
fertilizer_schedule.top_dress_1: Urea 65 kg/ha at crown root initiation (21-25 DAS)

crops.irrigation: 6 irrigations at: CRI, tillering, jointing, flowering, dough stage, maturity
crops.storage: Moisture below 12%; store in gunny bags on wooden pallets
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest at hard dough stage; moisture 20-22%; avoid delay to prevent shattering

crops.name: Cotton
crops.irrigation: Critical stages: germination, squaring, flowering, boll development
crops.storage: Keep dry below 8% moisture; avoid contact with damp surfaces
crops.harvesting_tips: Pick in morning hours; harvest when bolls open fully; 3-4 pickings needed

crops.name: Soybean

fertilizer_schedule.top_dress_1: Foliar spray of 2% Urea at flowering

crops.irrigation: Critical stages: flowering and pod filling; avoid waterlogging
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest when 95% leaves shed and pods turn brown; avoid over-drying

crops.name: Sugarcane

fertilizer_schedule.earthing_up: Urea 150 kg/ha + MOP 75 kg/ha at earthing up

crops.irrigation: Every 7-10 days in summer; every 15-20 days in winter
crops.storage: Crush within 48 hours of harvest for best sugar recovery
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest at 12-14 months; brix 18-20%; cut at ground level for good ratoon

crops.name: Maize (Corn)

fertilizer_schedule.top_dress_1: Urea 60 kg/ha at knee high stage

crops.irrigation: Critical stages: germination, knee-high, tasseling, grain filling
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest at physiological maturity (black layer stage); husk fully dried

crops.name: Groundnut

fertilizer_schedule.basal: SSP 375 kg/ha + Gypsum 250 kg/ha at pegging
fertilizer_schedule.top_dress: Foliar spray of 1% DAP at flower initiation

crops.irrigation: Critical stages: germination, flowering, pegging, pod filling
crops.storage: Moisture below 8-9%; aflatoxin risk management needed
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest when inner pod walls show dark markings; dig carefully to avoid losses

crops.name: Turmeric
crops.irrigation: Every 7-10 days; critical at rhizome development stage
crops.storage: Boil, dry to 6% moisture; store in cool dry place
crops.harvesting_tips: Harvest 7-9 months after planting when leaves turn yellow; boil within 48 hours

soil_types.characteristics: Highly fertile, good water retention, suitable for most crops
soil_types.improvement: Add organic matter; use green manures like Dhaincha

soil_types.characteristics: High clay content, swells when wet, cracks when dry, high fertility
soil_types.improvement: Deep ploughing; add phosphatic fertilizers; avoid waterlogging

soil_types.characteristics: Well-drained, low water retention, low fertility
soil_types.improvement: Add organic matter; lime application for acidic soils; micro-irrigation

soil_types.characteristics: Acidic, leached, poor fertility, hard when dry
soil_types.improvement: Lime application; add organic matter; terracing for erosion control

pests_diseases.name: Fall Armyworm
pests_diseases.symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves; frass (excrement) in whorl; damaged growing point
pests_diseases.identification: Brown/grey caterpillar up to 4cm; inverted Y on head capsule
pests_diseases.ipm_strategy: Scout weekly; use pheromone traps; apply insecticide in whorl at >1 larvae per plant

pests_diseases.name: Rice Blast
pests_diseases.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with grey center and brown border on leaves; neck rot at panicle base
pests_diseases.conditions: High humidity, cloudy weather, excess nitrogen
pests_diseases.severity: High - can cause complete crop failure in neck blast
pests_diseases.prevention: Use resistant varieties; balanced nutrition; avoid late nitrogen application

pests_diseases.name: Cotton Bollworm (American)
pests_diseases.symptoms: Circular holes in bolls; pin-hole entry with frass; damaged bolls drop
pests_diseases.ipm_strategy: Pheromone monitoring; avoid spraying 6AM-10AM when bees are active; rotate chemicals

pests_diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
pests_diseases.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves, stem, pods; leaves yellow and dry
pests_diseases.conditions: Dry conditions with high humidity; moderate temperatures 15-25°C
pests_diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties; avoid excess nitrogen; proper plant spacing

government_schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
government_schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land
government_schemes.how_to_apply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or nearest CSC center

government_schemes.name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
government_schemes.benefit: Insurance coverage for crop losses due to natural calamities
government_schemes.premium: Kharif: 2%, Rabi: 1.5%, Horticulture: 5% of sum insured
government_schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops; mandatory for loanee farmers
government_schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before cutoff date

government_schemes.name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
government_schemes.eligibility: Small & marginal farmers aged 18-40 years with landholding up to 2 hectares
government_schemes.how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest CSC center or maandhan.in

government_schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
government_schemes.benefit: Short-term credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, allied activities
government_schemes.credit_limit: Based on land holding and crop; typically ₹50,000-₹5,00,000
government_schemes.interest_rate: 7% per annum (2% subvention + 3% prompt repayment incentive)
government_schemes.eligibility: All farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs
government_schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at nearest bank branch or through cooperative societies

government_schemes.name: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana)
government_schemes.benefit: Subsidy on micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler)
government_schemes.eligibility: All farmers; priority to water scarce areas
government_schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through State Agriculture Department or pmksy.gov.in

government_schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
government_schemes.benefit: Free soil health card with crop-wise fertilizer recommendations
government_schemes.how_to_apply: Contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Department

government_schemes.name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
government_schemes.benefit: Online trading platform for better price discovery; direct market access
government_schemes.eligibility: Registered farmers; crops must be quality tested
government_schemes.how_to_register: Register at enam.gov.in with Aadhaar and bank details

vermicompost.benefits: Improves soil structure, water retention, microbial activity
vermicompost.production: Red earthworms (Eisenia fetida) process organic waste in 45-60 days

organic_farming.certification: Apply for India Organic certification through APEDA empanelled agencies
